value.name: lucia confirms halloran has the will
value.description: Lucia states that the will in question is the one Mr. Halloran has.
evidence: "That's the will Mr. Halloran has, yes."

value.name: daniel challenges lucia's answer
value.description: Daniel presses Lucia for a clearer answer and accuses her of avoiding the question.
evidence: "Lucia." Daniel's voice was the voice of a man who had been managing his sister since she was eight.
"Don't do this. Don't make it complicated.

value.name: daniel invokes mother's illness
value.description: Daniel argues that their mother was sick and medicated at the end, suggesting her wishes may not have been reliable.
evidence: "Mom was sick. She was on a lot of medication at the end."
"If you have feelings about what she might have wanted, we can talk about them, but feelings aren't documents."

value.name: lucia denies emotional argument
value.description: Lucia rejects Daniel's framing and insists she did not mention feelings.
evidence: "I didn't imply anything. I answered Ms. Patel's question."

value.name: asha interrupts the argument
value.description: Asha raises a finger to stop the siblings from talking over each other and regain control of the conversation.
evidence: "Asha lifted one finger half an inch off the table. Both of them stopped."
"It was a small trick and it worked on most families, at least the first time."

value.name: asha asks about modifying documents
value.description: Asha asks whether any formal or informal document, note, draft, or written conversation could alter the 2020 will.
evidence: "Let me ask it differently," she said.

"Is there any document, formal or informal, that either of you is aware of that might modify the terms of the 2020 will? A letter, a note, a draft, a conversation that was reduced to writing. Anything."

value.name: daniel denies any modifying document
value.description: Daniel immediately says he knows of no document that would change the will.

value.name: lucia hints at invalid statements
value.description: Lucia answers cautiously that she knows of nothing valid, implying she may have heard their mother say things that were not formalized.
evidence: "I don't know what's valid. That's her job."
"I'm not going to sit here and pretend I never heard Mom say things."

value.name: daniel reacts sharply to lucia
value.description: Daniel turns on Lucia angrily after her qualified answer, signaling tension and suspicion between them.
evidence: "Daniel turned to look at his sister so sharply that the legal pad slid an inch."
